name: Suqian Unitech Corp.,Ltd.
summary: Suqian Unitech Corp.,Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty chemicals in China and internationally. The company offers light stabilizers, compounding agents, intermediates, and polymerization inhibitors. Its products are used in various applications, including agricultural film, artificial grass, coatings, adhesives, synthetic fibers, engineering plastics, automotive modification, and plastic weaving. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Suqian, China.
